answer: Locks are recorded in zephyr, expire in signal, and opal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 38 aliases thus needs 170 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3271 identities would post 1888 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
